title: Intel Delivers Fastest Pentium II
scope_note: Introduces Pentium II 333 MHz and describes same-day system availability plus later-quarter server/workstation availability.

title: Intel Microprocessor Quick Reference Guide - Year
scope_note: Historical first-party chronology lists 1998 introductions for Pentium 266, Pentium II 333, Celeron 300, and Xeon 450.

title: Intel Introduces New Celeron Processor for Basic PCs
scope_note: Introduces Celeron 300 MHz and identifies Basic PC system announcements; exact component/boxed availability wording is limited.

title: Intel Announces Fastest Pentium II Xeon Processor
scope_note: Announces Xeon 450 MHz for two-way workstations/servers, planned system shipments later in October, and four-way availability in early 1999.

title: AMD Reports Fourth Quarter Results
scope_note: Retrospective filed release states 366, 380, and 400 MHz AMD-K6-2 versions were introduced and shipped in volume during Q4 1998.
